name: Volumetric Path Tracing with Transmittance Sampling and Multiple Scattering
aliases: Multiple Monochromatic Homogeneous Volumes with Multiple Scattering (Phase Function Sampling Only)
definition: A path tracer handling multiple scattering events within multiple homogeneous volumes, using only phase function sampling for direction selection, with no next event estimation or surface reflection (only emission).
summary: This method extends volumetric path tracing to handle multiple scattering in homogeneous media using phase function sampling, differing by managing multiple bounces and index-matched surfaces without surface reflection or refraction.
